question: where should one canonical copy of the weights live so a GPU can always be booked?

facts.volatility_note: per-datacenter availability is a live pool: the first read of this stage saw zero compatible cards in US-TX-3 and an L40S in US-MO-1; a read 23 minutes later saw an L40S back in US-TX-3. Exactly why one datacenter is not a plan.

global_volume.mount_kind: global (max 1 per Pod, no datacenter constraint, GPU and CPU)

A_regional_tx3_only.summary: keep only uwgeaie5b0 and wait for capacity in US-TX-3
A_regional_tx3_only.why: zero compatible cards with availability in US-TX-3 at the time of the read

B_regional_replica_mo1.summary: use the verified copy on y92bt25ru8 in US-MO-1
B_regional_replica_mo1.why: a real GPU answer was produced from this volume on 2026-10-13 and L40S 48 GB is available there now at $1.09/h

C_global_volume_whole_tree.summary: copy the whole /workspace tree to the global volume and mount it at /workspace
C_global_volume_whole_tree.compatible_gpus_available_now: every datacenter in the catalogue (no pin)
C_global_volume_whole_tree.monthly_storage_usd: global rate NOT PUBLISHED; scenarios in monthly-storage-cost.json
C_global_volume_whole_tree.migration_cost_usd: ≈0.06 one-time (CPU Pod + request classes), see migration-cost.json
C_global_volume_whole_tree.why: the public API can attach it, but the launch script writes to the mount and mmap/startup on object-backed storage has not been measured

D_global_weights_local_runtime.summary: global volume holds only the GGUF; llama.cpp runs from local storage
D_global_weights_local_runtime.compatible_gpus_available_now: every datacenter in the catalogue (no pin)
D_global_weights_local_runtime.monthly_storage_usd: global rate NOT PUBLISHED; scenarios in monthly-storage-cost.json
D_global_weights_local_runtime.migration_cost_usd: ≈0.06 one-time + a local runtime delivery step per start
D_global_weights_local_runtime.why: avoids object-storage small-file reads, but requires the runtime to be shipped in the image or fetched at every start (adds startup time and cost)

recommendation.why: zero migration, zero new infrastructure, a verified copy, and capacity right now
recommendation.strategic: C_global_volume_whole_tree, then D if C's startup latency is unacceptable
recommendation.guard: neither global option may be called compatible before one GPU Pod loads the GGUF from it; that Pod is a paid action and is NOT part of the $2 LIVE envelope
